doc: world/bookings.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: bookable claims, slot rules, seeded windows, feed shapes. The Book is the public calendar the request form reads before any money moves — prices live in requests.json / the monetization plan PROPOSAL, never here.

window_min.weather: the block you bought is the window (60/120/240)

rules.review: human review at filing — exclusives always get eyes; a booked request is already approved when its window arrives
rules.price: same flat block price — a time slot is not an upgrade; surge keys off the window's local hour and is shown before payment
rules.cancel: full refund until the window starts — after that it is a live exclusive
rules.conflict: a booked window claims the resource for that span; an overlapping ask queues for the next free window — FCFS, never auctioned
rules.cooldown: bookings never skip cooldowns — the picker never offers a slot that opens inside a cooldown tail
rules.one_per: one event per place per 24 h — unchanged
rules.horizon_note: the book shows the next 24 h only — farther out is a queue's job, and queued slots already hold ≤24 h

windows.what: fog burn-off for the morning crowd

feed_shapes.doc: the book adds no new status — it reuses the live feed vocabulary (requests.json feed_vocabulary)
lines: booked request cancelled before the window — refunded
never: a new status chip — booking is a schedule, not a state
a price on a slot — a time slot is not an upgrade
a queue position or an auction

live_seam.doc: merge seam — same pattern as requests.json live_seam

reads.gsViewerState().calendar: optional — [{claim, start_min, min, who, what}] booked windows render on the strip beside demo seeds, deduped by claim+start

live_seam.write: gsRequestSubmit gains start_slot (minutes-from-now) when the filer picked a window — the bus books it like any exclusive; absent the field, behavior is today
live_seam.fallback: seeded windows stand in for bookings the bus doesn't name; the strip never lies about what it can't see

demo.note: book.html renders the next 24 h live; a seeded window whose start already passed today rolls to tomorrow. In request.html a filed booking counts down at 30 min/tick so the fire path is reachable.
